h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tumkur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tumkur

items.pText: A lot of new building in Tumkur, from engineering colleges to housing projects near the industrial area, is designed by architects based in Bengaluru, a short drive down the highway. FunPlay Systems works with these architects, and directly with schools, colleges and parks. We make all our outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 810 km away.

Tumkur, also written Tumakuru, is a district headquarters in southern Karnataka, known for the Siddaganga Math and its many educational institutions. The weather is milder than in the plains further north, with a monsoon from June to October. Equipment comes from Vasai by road and is fixed on site by our installation team or a dealer in south India. Send us your site plan, and we will return a layout drawing with every safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Working with your architect on a play area

c: Architects usually want three things from us early: the footprint of each piece, the safe play area around it and the type of base it needs. Our layout drawing gives all of these, so the play area can go onto the site plan before levels and drains are fixed. Tell us if the area sits on a podium or over a basement, because that decides between self-standing and grouted installation.
